source_caption:
Paul Walkers first scene as ‘Brian O’Connor’ in the Green Mitsubishi Eclipse in “The Fast and the Furious” (2001)

The Fast and the Furious (2001) is an action thriller about Brian O’Conner (Paul Walker), an undercover LAPD officer who infiltrates an underground street racing circuit. Tasked with investigating a series of high-tech semi-truck hijackings, he befriends alpha-racer Dominic Toretto (Vin Diesel) but must ultimately choose between his badge and his new loyalty.

source_details.synopsis: The Fast and the Furious is a 2001 action film directed by Rob Cohen, and written by Gary Scott Thompson, Erik Bergquist, and David Ayer, based on the 1998 Vibe magazine article "Racer X" by Ken Li. The first installment in the Fast & Furious franchise, it stars Paul Walker, Vin Diesel, Michelle Rodriguez, Jordana Brewster, Rick Yune, Chad Lindberg, Johnny Strong, and Ted Levine. In the film, undercover cop Brian O'Conner (Walker) infiltrates a street racing crew to investigate a series of hijackings and finds himself developing a complex friendship with the group's leader, Dominic Toretto (Diesel).
